verdict.rationale: Docs describe building long-lived, autonomous agent processes (agent loop, streaming input mode as persistent process, production hosting/scaling/multi-tenant isolation, session persistence/resumption) and Claude Code's 'agent view' for monitoring background sessions and subagents/agent teams for parallel autonomous work. This directly supports setting up background automations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of long-running unattended automations in practice and no first-party dedicated 'scheduling/cron' automation feature beyond session persistence and hosting guidance.
